steps.js: (()=>{const q=[...document.querySelectorAll('main input,main textarea,main button,main [role=switch],main [role=tab],main [role=combobox],main [role=slider],main select,main a[href]')];return q.filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length).map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [e.tagName.toLowerCase(),e.getAttribute('role')||'',(e.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,38),e.placeholder||'',e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',e.id||'',(e.value==null?'':String(e.value)).slice(0,12),Math.round(r.x)+','+Math.round(r.y)+' '+Math.round(r.width)+'x'+Math.round(r.height)].join('|')})})()
